summary: Proximity chat feature testing completed. Backend: 19/19 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All critical UI elements present and working. WebSocket: All proximity events functional. Core features from iterations 1-2 still working.

issues: Location permission required to access proximity chat features (expected behavior). Radius selector and 'Join Area Chat' button hidden until permission granted. This is correct security/privacy design.

critical_code_review_comments: ✓ POST /api/proximity/join endpoint working correctly with GeoHash room ID generation
✓ POST /api/proximity/leave endpoint working correctly with participant count decrement
✓ GET /api/proximity/room/{room_id} returns room info with participants
✓ GET /api/proximity/messages/{room_id} returns messages (only non-expired)
✓ POST /api/proximity/messages sends message with 24h expiry field
✓ Non-participant correctly rejected with 403 when trying to send message
✓ GeoHash encoding produces correct precision for all radius options (10m=8, 50m=7, 100m=6, 500m=5)
✓ Two users at same location get same room_id (geohash clustering working)
✓ Different radius creates different room_id (correct room isolation)
✓ MongoDB TTL index exists on proximity_messages.expires_at with expireAfterSeconds=0
✓ Socket.IO proximity events working: join_proximity, leave_proximity, send_proximity_message
✓ proximity_message event broadcasts to all room participants
✓ proximity_user_joined event broadcasts when user joins room
✓ proximity_user_left event broadcasts when user leaves room
✓ Multi-user proximity chat working (2 users receive each other's messages)
✓ Auto-leave on disconnect working (user removed from room on socket disconnect)
✓ Frontend: Nearby tab accessible with location permission request
✓ Frontend: Tab navigation working (Chats, Nearby, Profile)
✓ Frontend: All testID attributes present for automated testing
✓ Frontend: Proximity chat screen structure correct (header, expiry banner, message input)
✓ Message expiry field is exactly 24 hours from creation time
